item.tib: zhi khro rdzu 'phrul dra ba 'jig byed gshin rje gshed dmar spyi 'dul khro bcu yab yum kyi bsad pa'i 'khor lo spu gri 'bar ba
item.coloph: ces yi dam 'jig byed chen po gshin rje gshed kyi khro bo bcu yi bsad pa'i 'khor lo spu gri 'bar ba 'di ni/ dbal mo las kyi thig le bsad 'khor gyi gong gnon nye bar mkho ru/ rje zla bral chen po gsang sngags grags pa khu dbon gyi bka' yis bskul ba dang / bstan 'dzin nor bu sku mched gnyis kyi zhabs bstis che cher mdzad pa'i ngor/ snyigs ma'i kho bo kun grol grags pa 'ja' tshon snying po gang shar rang grol du 'bod pa yis/ shar rgyal mo rgya yi rong chen gyi zhing khams phyogs bzhir phye ba'i nub phyogs dbang gi gnad/ dge bshes rgyal po bstan 'dzin nor bu rin po che'i dbang la bsgyur ba'i yul gru bon gyi mkhas mang rgya mtsho'i 'dun sa lhun grub dpag bsam ljon pa'i gling chen du dmar ser can gyi lo snron gyi zla ba'i lha tshes dang po la bgyis pa 'dis kyang gsang sngags bon gyi bstan pa'i 'phrin las thams cad phyogs la rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
